text: Audited where bun and Node are required: bun for `workspace:` dependencies in four packages, `bun:test` in five test files, and `Bun.serve` in the UI mock; Node for the `node`-shebang tsc, Vite and VitePress binaries and the plain-JS engine build that `npx yolo-twice` uses. Recommends bun-only: add `--bun` to the build scripts and ship the engine as per-platform `bun build --compile` binaries on GitHub releases, which removes the Node requirement for users. Nothing was changed; `bun --bun run build` for the UI succeeded, but the engine-under-bun check failed with "Module not found packages/engine/dist/cli.js", so that claim is unverified.
